article.title: Where to eat in Hong Kong
article.excerpt: Anywhere near downtown virtually all of the good places are quite expensive. The good news is that there are many of them and they are quite fine indeed. Two I can recommend are Mott 32 and Ye Shanghai , near Central and Admiralty respectively. My favorite meal of the trip was out at Sha Tin 18 , in the New Territories Hyatt.
